evidence_snapshot.hash_definition: SHA-256(status_bytes + diff_bytes + untracked_bytes), excluding this evidence JSON. status_bytes uses git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all. diff_bytes uses git diff HEAD --binary --no-ext-diff --no-color. untracked_bytes concatenates raw-path-sorted path + NUL + hex SHA-256 of contents or symlink target bytes + NUL. Source and configuration digests cover the working tree.
